donnees.titre: Inferonasal MIMS® Procedure: Long-Term Follow-Up Extension Study
donnees.titre_officiel: Minimally Invasive Micro Sclerostomy (MIMS®) Inferonasal Procedure: Long-Term Follow-Up Extension Study
donnees.raison_arret: The study was terminated following completion of the Week 24 visit. The Week 30 follow-up visit was canceled due to internal company reasons.

criteres_principaux.critere: Change in Number of Topical Intraocular Pressure Lowering Medications (Baseline to 24 Months)
criteres_principaux.delai: Medicated baseline to 24 months post-MIMS® surgery

donnees.resume_source: A long-term (24 and 30 months) follow-up extension, prospective, non-interventional, open label study for data collection from subjects who underwent prior MIMS® inferonasal surgery, in continuation of the previous clinical investigation with the MIMS® Device (MMS-EEU-5).

bras.description: Cohort that includes subjects that have undergone the MIMS® inferonasal surgery.
interventions: Device: Inferonasal Minimally Invasive Micro Sclerostomy

Inclusion Criteria:
